name: Mankind Pharma Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Mankind Pharma Limited develops, manufactures, and markets pharmaceutical formulations in various acute and chronic therapeutic areas and several consumer healthcare products.[1]
keyPoints: Leadership[1] - #1 Rank in Prescriptions over the last 8 yrs. - #2 Rank by volume & #4 Rank by value in IPM - 4 Consumer healthcare brands ranked #1 in their categories.
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -3.88%

announcements.text: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS 19 Nov - Please find attached intimation regarding allotment of 38,442 equity shares pursuant to ESOP Plan
Change In Corporate Office Address Of RTA 13 Nov - KFin Technologies, Mankind Pharma's RTA, shifts corporate office from December 1, 2026.

Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation 6 Nov - Mankind Pharma will participate in the 2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London from November 16-19, 2026.
Intimation Regarding ESG Rating 5 Nov - SES assigned Mankind Pharma an ESG rating of 64.8 for FY26.
